summary: The import stays within the agreed scope. All required artifacts are present: scope, README, imports.json ledger, validation.json, status.json, check_isolation.py and all five logs. The logs match the supplied validation summary: 703 paths with 698 byte-preserved and 5 reconciled, 703 source blobs, 47 PR187 snapshots and 109 links; the PR299 verifier recorded 637 files, 48 samples, 24 pairs and the acfd029 head; PR299 tests 5 OK and PR187 tests 6 OK; the isolation output lists only maintained GPU test files. The navigation pages match the source reports. PR187/208 figures checked: +10.17% B/A, about 2 s versus about 1.1 s first batch, +2.14 s remaining loop, +3.34 s total wall time, unresolved ±5% remaining-loop equivalence, +0.51% C/B, inconclusive one-BD result. PR299 points checked: 48 samples in six cases, uncontrolled cache, C1 unfixed at acfd029, Run77 deferred, no universal no-regression claim. No conclusion is strengthened. Isolation settings are consistent across root conftest collect_ignore, Ruff force-exclude/extend-exclude, five pre-commit rewrite/AST hooks (YAML, merge-conflict and size checks stay active), Meson exclude_directories and Hatch exclude plus negated artifacts. The fixture-based checker exercises each of these. No runtime or example files were found changed in the inspected areas. Two low, non-blocking issues are about how the ledger labels pages and where the one-off checker lives.
checks: Read scope.md, README.md, status.json, validation.json, check_isolation.py and all five logs; log contents match the validation.json summary and the supplied coordinator evidence.

Reviewed check_pr_import.py: per-file hash, executable-bit and safe-path checks; exact source-delta and cat-file blob identity under --source-git; PR187 47-snapshot manifest hashes; relative-link resolution.

Reviewed conftest.py collect_ignore, .pre-commit-config.yaml exclusions (trailing-whitespace, end-of-file-fixer, mixed-line-ending, check-ast, debug-statements), pyproject Ruff and Hatch exclude/artifact negations, and psana/meson.build exclude_directories.
Confirmed no files under gpu/notes match test*.py, so excluding notes from collection hides no maintained tests.
No imported ledger entry is 1 MB or larger (searched for 7+ digit byte counts), so check-added-large-files (10 MB) stays satisfiable.
Compared docs/performance/README.md and history.md claims line by line with pr187_pr208.md (lines 5-15, 71-84, 146-260, 287-291) and pr299_perlmutter_20261115.md (lines 1-40, 148-158).
Reviewed GPU README navigation: current API links are retained and performance/history links were added.
Reviewed the read_staging.md and user_kernels.md headers: they only add a link to the PR187/208 report.
Checked IMPLEMENTATION.md and proposals/performance_campaigns.md line 132 (three-way reconcile policy) against the import approach.
limitations: No commands were run, so git diff, blob identity and source-delta coverage could not be checked independently. Those rely on the coordinator's logs and the checker code.

I could not see the pre-import (base 12366915) versions of read_staging.md, user_kernels.md and the GPU README. Whether newer feature-branch content was kept for the two pages copied exactly from source is therefore inferred, not observed.
I did not read all 182k imported lines; only reports, navigation, ledger entries and logs were spot-checked.
Tests, the verifier and the isolation checks were not executed by the reviewer. The results come from the logs and validation.json only.
Hatch support for negated artifact patterns is accepted on the basis of check_isolation.py's use of the real hatchling WheelBuilder, not reproduced.

findings.evidence: read_staging.md (lines 118-127) and user_kernels.md (lines 129-138) are labeled policy 'reconciled-navigation', but imported_sha256 equals source_sha256 for both, so they are byte-identical to the PR187/208 source. The README's '61 exact / five reconciled' and the validation's 'byte-preserved: 698' therefore undercount exact files: only README.md, performance/README.md and history.md actually differ from source. check_pr_import.py:38-41 skips the source-hash check for reconciled entries. The ledger also records no pre-import base blob for the three 'M' pages, so nothing shows that the three-way reconcile required by proposals/performance_campaigns.md:132 kept any newer feature-branch content in those two pages.
findings.requested_change: Either reclassify the two pages as byte-preserved, or add a field such as base_sha256 / reconciliation_result (e.g. 'base equals delta-base; source taken unchanged') for each reconciled page and correct the 61/5 and 698/5 statements accordingly. No scientific content needs to change.

findings.evidence: This one-off import checker sits in the maintained, installable scripts/performance/analysis/ tree, which Meson and Hatch do not exclude. It hard-codes the RECORD path under gpu/notes, which is excluded from installation, along with the counts 703/698/5/47. An installed copy cannot run. It is also not Ruff-excluded, and lines 60-61 use semicolon-joined statements (E702, part of Ruff's default E7 set). No Ruff CI hook was found, so the effect is minor.
findings.requested_change: Optionally move it beside the import record under notes/pr_campaign_import_20261116/, or state in its docstring that it is source-checkout only. Split the semicolon statements so a future Ruff run passes. Not required for this import.
